title:
From traditional data warehousing to a modern lakehouse
A practical journey with Databricks
lead:
Looking to move beyond rigid, Excel-fed data warehouses into a faster, scalable data platform? This whitepaper by Geert Wouters distills a real-world migration from classic Kimball + ETL to a modern lakehouse: What changed, why it mattered and how to execute without business disruption.

You’ll get a clear roadmap (from first assessment to phased cutover), practical design choices, lessons learned and the tangible outcomes teams can expect in performance, governance and AI-readiness.

Ready to modernize your data foundation? Download the whitepaper below.
